name: Grandma Finds The Internet
look: An elderly woman with curly white hair and a light blue patterned blouse holds her glasses up to her eyes and stares at an open laptop, mouth slightly open in amazement. A mustard yellow wall and a red chair are behind her, and a black mouse sits on the desk.
use: An advice-animal style macro about an older person meeting the internet. The top line names something she finds online and the bottom line shows her naive, literal or outdated way of dealing with it.
slots: top caption: the online thing she discovers
bottom caption: her naive or confused way of using it
examples: Asks if her photos will get wet

grandma squinting at the computer screen amazed
elderly woman peering at laptop with surprised face
old woman with white hair discovering something online
